tasks.title: Validate generated Invoice intake and approval
steps: Preserve this responsibility and linked requirements: Proposed composed invoice-workflow delivery unit on IBM Code Engine. Sydney (au-syd) remains proposed within the accepted Australian data boundary. Owns browser/API, background worker, isolated PDF/OCR parser, IBM Cloud Databases for PostgreSQL transactional job queue/outbox and review state, private versioned IBM Cloud Object Storage originals, IBM Cloud App ID staff sign-in, separate workload identities and regional watsonx extraction. Supports twenty signed-in staff and three reviewers; ordinary uploaders cannot approve. Server-side SQL membership gates review and approval independently of sign-in and workload IAM. Accepts Confidential PDF invoices containing possible personal data, up to 10,000,000 bytes (decimal 10 MB), at 500 uploads per day with bursts of twenty. Qualify durable admission for that burst without assuming twenty simultaneous extraction workers or an unprovided completion deadline. Jobs may take several minutes: return a stable job identity and expose persisted progress/status independently of the upload HTTP request. Extract supplier, invoice date, total and currency into a review queue linked to original source evidence; invalid, failed or uncertain extraction remains visible for staff resolution. Only the isolated parser handles untrusted PDF bytes, without model, database, object-store or accounting identity. Persist stable invoice/job identity, document version and business state with queue/outbox changes atomically in PostgreSQL. Fence worker leases, recover stalled jobs after crashes and preserve identity across retries. Proposed bounded retry policy uses backoff, attempt/deadline limits and durable terminal-failure records as a dead-letter/recovery path; authorized recovery retains original identity and audit history. Repeated delivery must not create duplicate invoice records. Approval binds the authorized reviewer to the exact source/result revision and destination operation; edits require renewed approval. Persist the outbound operation identity and payload digest before sending approved fields. Retry only under the independently accepted destination idempotency contract, retaining the same operation identity and payload; uncertain outcomes are held for receipt reconciliation rather than blindly resent or assigned a fresh identity. Existing accounting remains external: an administrator supplies its reviewed HTTPS endpoint and credentials through protected deployment inputs and secret storage, never through the diagram or browser. Retain originals and extraction audit history for 90 days with scheduled cleanup and reviewed object-version/backup expiry; retention clock and final deletion timing remain acceptance details. Documents, extracted data and copies containing them remain in Australia, including inference, recovery copies and sensitive diagnostics; no silent overseas fallback. Owns audit history, maintenance, recovery procedures, monitoring tasks and restricted operator recovery. Current scope remains staff PDF upload, extraction, review and approved accounting submission. Operating ownership remains unresolved. Regional Code Engine, PostgreSQL, object storage, App ID, selected watsonx model and private-connectivity availability remain unverified. Artifact/registry replication geography, model-processing policy, dependency security, retention behavior, restore and alert delivery need independent acceptance. Acceptance must cover uploader approval denial, stale approval rejection, burst admission, multi-minute processing, duplicate delivery, worker crashes, bounded retry exhaustion, authorized recovery and lost accounting responses without duplicate submission. Local reviewed practice evidence is not validation of this composition or destination..

Inspect terraform/main.tf.json, invoice-contract.json and resource-schedule.json. This composition generates the API, worker, isolated PDF parser, private originals/SQL queue, native staff identities and separate operating tasks. Additional drawn scope remains visible and blocks incomplete exports.

Follow the explicit foundation → immutable image publication → manual SQL/bootstrap/membership → operating schedule/alert acceptance → application release sequence. Cloud access, publication, apply and migrations each require existing authorization.
Record the actual requirement-to-test outcomes, remaining destination/compatibility/security findings and approved owner decisions. No task is complete on generation alone.
